items.summary: The Board of Supervisors called the meeting to order and conducted the initial roll call for attendance. All members were present, and attendees were led in the Pledge of Allegiance.

The Clerk communicated the election credentials and confirmation of surety bonds for newly elected and re-elected supervisors following the November 5, 2024 election. The Clerk explained that formal oaths were taken earlier that day before the Mayor's inauguration.
Presiding Judge of the San Francisco Superior Court administered the ceremonial oath of office to the newly elected and re-elected members of the Board of Supervisors.

Nominations opened for the office of Board President. Supervisor Dorsey nominated Supervisor Rafael Mandelman, seconded and supported with remarks by Supervisor Connie Chan, with no other nominations offered.

speakers.name: Matt Dorsey
speakers.quote: it is my honor to place the name of rafael mandelman to nomination for pedestrian san francisco board of supervisors.

speakers.name: Connie Chan
speakers.quote: I want to express my support for supervisor mandelman presidency and lead us.

items.summary: Members of the public provided general public comment. Speakers congratulated the incoming supervisors, offered praise for Rafael Mandelman's nomination, and addressed concerns including downtown street conditions, the arts budget, and racial disparities in fatal overdoses.
public_comment_themes: Congratulations to new supervisors and support for Rafael Mandelman
Disparities in overdose deaths affecting Black residents

items.summary: The Board of Supervisors voted unanimously to elect Rafael Mandelman as Board President for a two-year term. Following the vote, President Mandelman assumed the dais and led a land acknowledgment and a moment of silence for former President Jimmy Carter.

speakers.name: Rafael Mandelman
speakers.quote: it is a tremendous honor to serve the resident in my district, this board, beautiful city as a whole.

items.summary: President Mandelman introduced the Mayor of San Francisco to deliver remarks to the chamber.

Newly inaugurated Mayor Daniel Lurie addressed the Board of Supervisors, commending the unanimous vote for President Mandelman and pledging transparent, open partnership between the executive and legislative branches to deliver results for the city.

speakers.name: Mayor
speakers.quote: As your mayor working along side the board PRESIDENT That we are going to have honest, open transparent conversation at all times

items.summary: Newly elected, re-elected, and continuing members of the Board of Supervisors delivered remarks outlining their legislative priorities, thanking family and supporters, and sharing reflections on public service. Priorities highlighted included housing production, public safety, budget oversight, and community unity.

items.summary: Board President Rafael Mandelman delivered inaugural remarks reflecting on the history of the Board, the responsibilities of leadership, and the balance between social justice and effective governance. The meeting was then adjourned.

speakers.name: Rafael Mandelman
speakers.quote: There can be no social justice without effective government and government cannot exceed without social justice. Our task is to figure out how to pursue both
